businessActivity2021.label: Business activity supported by Shopify merchants (2021 study)
businessActivity2021.period: calendar 2021 (study published April 2022; older than the FY2024 snapshot, the latest commissioned edition with country figures found)
businessActivity2021.definition: Deloitte: 'Business Activity represents the impact on the gross output and is interpreted as the value of economic transactions throughout supply chains associated with production of goods and services'; direct, indirect and induced impacts of Shopify merchants' sales, gross (not incremental) impacts, from an input-output model.

jobs2021.label: Jobs supported by Shopify merchants (2021 study)
jobs2021.definition: Deloitte 'Job impact': 'Employment represents the number of persons engaged in producing output for final goods and services. In the case of the six countries (Argentina, Brazil, Canada, Israel, Mexico and the United States) employment represents the number of jobs.' Includes direct, indirect and induced jobs; figures rounded.

economicActivity.label: Economic activity of Shopify's ecosystem
economicActivity.period: year ending June 30, 2026 (newer than the FY2024 snapshot; no earlier state table could be fetched)
economicActivity.definition: Shopify: 'Economic activity includes the direct, indirect, and induced effects of merchant sales and partner activity', estimated 'with an input-output framework using merchant sales, partner revenue, and OECD global supply-chain data' (Shopify Economic Impact Summary). A modelled estimate, not reported sales. The report does not state how merchants are assigned to states.

jobsSupported.label: Jobs supported by Shopify's ecosystem
jobsSupported.period: year ending June 30, 2026 (newer than the FY2024 snapshot)
jobsSupported.definition: Shopify: 'Jobs supported estimates the number of people engaged in direct, indirect, and induced business activity across Shopify's ecosystem and related supply chains.' Printed rounded to thousands (e.g. '12K').

notes: Two editions, kept under separate metric keys so they are never mixed. Countries (17) and the EU come from Deloitte's 'Global Economic Impact Study of Shopify, 2021 Refresh' (Shopify engaged Deloitte; tier company-commissioned), the PDF Shopify attaches to its April 28, 2022 newsroom release; it is the newest commissioned edition with country figures found before mid-2025. The EU region overlaps the FR/DE/IT/NL/ES/SE rows and is not a sum. Deloitte says state-level metrics are only in an Excel Data Book that is not published, so no 2021 state data. The May 2023 Shopify Entrepreneurship Index (2022 data, with Deloitte) covered 40 countries and all states, but its pages (shopify.com/media/index-beta) now return 404 and the press release gives only California figures, so it is not used. State rows come from Shopify's own 2026 'The Entrepreneur Effect' report (year ending June 30, 2026; tier company-published; no outside modeller named): 50 states, no DC row; its 'Territories/Other' row ($5.5B, 19K) is not mapped. Its 9-market country table (same 2026 period) is not used, to avoid mixing eras with the Deloitte country rows. Values printed as $…M (AK, ND, WV) are stored in billions (e.g. $583M = 0.583); jobs printed as '12K' are stored as 12000. All figures are modelled gross impacts including indirect and induced effects. Shopify owns no real property (10-K Item 2) and is remote-first, so sites are only its two principal executive office addresses.
